messages.content: Explain in exactly three sentences why floating-point addition is not associative.
Explain in exactly three sentences why floating-point addition is not associative.

samples.text: Floating-point addition is not associative because the order in which you add numbers can affect the result due to the way floating-point numbers are represented and stored in computer memory. This is because the addition of floating-point numbers involves a combination of integer arithmetic and rounding, which can lead to different results depending on the order of operations. For example, the sum of a + b + c can be different from (a + b) + c due to rounding errors, making floating-point addition non-associative.
